summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, reporting surface exploration results at its Blanket mine in Zimbabwe. The press release details drill results indicating a new gold zone with oxide and sulphide mineralization, with highlights such as 23m at 2.61 g/t gold. This is a routine operational update on exploration drilling and metallurgical test work, not a special situation event. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other specified special-situations category. As a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 6-K, it falls outside the defined categories and is classified as 'None.'
